entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Survivors of abuse in care say last year's changes to the redress system have made little difference to their lives | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

RNZ senior reporter Tim Brown sat down with Warren Tait and Alan Nixon.

They're among the survivors who believe they're still owed recognition and compensation for the abuse they faced as children.

Content warning: This story discusses sexual abuse.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/politics/616490/i-ve-lost-my-whole-life-survivors-speak-one-year-on-from-changes-to-redress
